description: Exempts installation of the PowerPack (new sealed air filter housing, cone air filter, intake tube, MAF tube with integrated HCT, throttle body, throttle body adapter, and ECU reflash) on 2018-2021 Ford Mustang 5.0L.
notes: 2-page document, fully legible; no Exhibit/table, fitment stated only in body prose (no per-vehicle part-number breakdown). Document also mentions the PCV/crankcase breather hose may be replaced with SAE30R9-rated hose and the body control module can be reflashed to correct the speedometer after tire/gear-ratio changes; not captured as separate part numbers since none are given for those items. Induction/cylinders not stated in document, left null.
